sentences.text: Genusaurus is a genus of abelisaurid theropod dinosaurs whose name means "knee lizard".
This animal possessed elongated dorsal vertebrae.
The pelvic elements of Genusaurus were strongly fused.
It had a cnemial crest on its tibia that extended strongly forward and curved upward.
In 2016, Genusaurus was estimated to be 3.6 meters long, making it one of the smallest known abelisaurids.
Genusaurus sisteronis is the only named species within the genus Genusaurus.
The type specimen of Genusaurus is a partial skeleton found between 1984 and 1986 in the Albian Bevons Beds.
Genusaurus was named and described by Hugues Accarie and colleagues in 1995.
The specific name sisteronis refers to the town of Sisteron near where the fossil was discovered.
A 2008 analysis placed Genusaurus in the family Noasauridae alongside Laevisuchus, Masiakasaurus, Noasaurus, and Velocisaurus.
In 2025, Eric Buffetaut suggested placing Genusaurus into Furileusauria, confirming its classification as an abelisaurid.
Genusaurus is classified within the subfamily Majungasaurinae.
Genusaurus lived during the Albian stage of the Early Cretaceous, approximately 112 to 100 million years ago.
Fossils of Genusaurus have been found in France.
The time range for Genusaurus is estimated between 110.1 and 106.3 million years ago.
